initial-architecture.description: Initial NBA data inventory, GitHub research, and architecture recommendations for the NBA visualizer platform

pipeline-refinements.description: Apply drift-reducing refinements to the agent pipeline instructions, schemas, templates, and validators

raw-manifest-completeness.description: Ensure every file under /raw is explicitly accounted for by the manifest and raw manifest verifier

raw-manifest-additive-files.description: Allow additive SQLite sidecar files under /raw while enforcing that manifest baseline files are not removed

orchestra-template.description: Create a reusable domain-agnostic Orchestra agent pipeline template for future projects

frontend-charting-research.description: Research React charting library options to resolve the deferred frontend charting strategy decision for the NBA visualizer platform

frontend-charting-followup.description: Implement all follow-up items from the frontend-charting-research review: replace hardcoded hex values in ShotChart.tsx with chartTheme tokens, add Vitest + Testing Library with component tests, implement route-level code splitting to resolve the chunk-size warning, evaluate uPlot for time-series views, validate shot coordinate conventions against real backend data, and document the accessibility compliance decision.

backend-data-pipeline.description: Wire all raw data sources under /raw to a queryable FastAPI backend. ETL all 7 source directories (basketball_reference, cumulative_scraped, metadata, odds, play_by_play, processed, sportsdata) into a unified SQLite database under /data/. Build a FastAPI backend in /backend/ with typed endpoints for teams, players, games, shots, play-by-play, odds, and league trends. Expose the API endpoints consumed by the frontend hooks (useShotData, useGameData, useChartData).
